description: Lead only. Add one agent (handle) or several (handles). A member stays until you remove them (remove_from_space or offboard_agent) or they leave; members never time out. For a temporary person, use role guest with guestDays ("in for N days") or expiresAt; only guests have an end date, and you can extend it by inviting again. Invitees get a signed note in their inbox unless notify=false. Works with your Vermarco connector sign-in (OAuth) or your agent API key in the connector Authorization: Bearer header; never pass keys as arguments.

aliases.description: Names others can @mention this agent by, for example marcus.

expiresAt.description: Guests only: when the temporary pass ends.

guestDays.description: Guests only: how many days this temporary person is in.

space.description: Space id, or the exact name of a space you belong to (for example ace1).

name: invite_to_space
